quote_text:
It's a long time since Spurs had two Argentineans starring in the FA Cup, what did you make of Lo Celso and Lamela today?
Do you want me to call them Ardiles and Villa? No. They played very well. Ardiles and Villa
would not be ashamed of them for sure. They played very well. The team played very well
especially in the first half.
The second half we started ok but then gave some sloppy reactions to let them feel their
way back into the game. Jonathan [Woodgate] was not sleeping, he was awake, he was reading
the game. He brought on Gestede alongside Fletcher and they started playing long balls, second balls.
They scored the goal and we had to defend. But the majority of the game our energy was
there. We should have scored more goals and killed the cup tie.
But I am happy with Lamela and Gio. Lamela was out for so long, he has been coming back
step by step. Playing 20 minutes here, half an hour against Liverpool and 90 here. You
could see his fitness is coming.
And Gio again has been step by step. He was so so good against Liverpool and so so good
here again. I am happy with the boys. They played with intensity. And I am happy with result obviously.
What did you make of Japhet Tanganga's performance in a more attacking role?
I think it's more for you to analyse that me. My analysis of him brought him to where
he is now. Brought him to two full games, debut in the Premier League, debut in the FA Cup.
That's the way I like kids. They don't think about modern philosophies of trying to have
a pathway into the team. At this age it’s work, work, work and more work and wait for the right opportunity.
For me that’s the message to the young players at our club. The pathway is work, work and
work and then when the right moment arrives you prove you are ready for it.
You mentioned Middlesbrough went direct with Gestede, how did you feel your defence dealt with that?
You know it was not just Gestede, it was him and Fletcher. Two strong boys in the air, a style of game that
creates problems to everybody. I always say that you cannot press the ball in the air. You have to try to stop
the long balls but for that the line has to be up. They did that when the fatigue was there. They did that
when Giovani, when Lamela, when Eriksen, they start dropping back and not stopping so well as they did for
the majority of the game. So long balls to the box and we dealt very well with every set piece. I think they had a
quite high number of corners and lateral free-kicks and we dealt well with it.
In the situation they scored, I think outside the box if I'm not wrong, it was Saville with his bad foot. But then they
were in the game for the last ten minutes and credit to them for that.
Southampton in the next round, are you looking forward to meeting up with some friends on the touchline again and get some revenge?
They are on fire, they are winning matches, home and away. Great results. They were in
the dark zone and now they are shining. Credit to them. We know it's going to be a difficult
tie. Luck is not with us in the draws.
Two away, two difficult matches, Middlesbrough and now Southampton, but it is what it is.
Southampton I think also they will feel they could have a much easier tie. We are going
to be ready, I hope.
We were expecting an announcement on Gedson Fernandes, any update on that?
Any news? No news. I didn't
want to know anything during the day. During the day it was just about the game. He doesn't
have news for me so nothing.
Christian Eriksen was booed when the teams were read out before the match, does that
make it more difficult to convince him to stay?
He played very well. Played very well, very professional which is what I expect from him.
If his decision is to leave I think he has to leave with his head up, if he gives everything
which is what he tries to do for the team. Fans, it's always to respect, we have to respect
but I think the boy did it for us today.
